title: Hope for the Best, Prepare for the Worst: Digital Collaboration and Asset Retrieval
summary: President Hughes shares hopeful emails from quarantined, evacuated missionaries and announces a cross-border digital initiative: asking them to submit recorded Tagalog lessons for peer feedback. He outlines plans to retrieve food and water assets from empty apartments in San Jose del Monte to fortify remaining missionaries, reiterating the rule to reorder water when two jugs remain. Finally, he warns of strict government detention risks for violating quarantine protocols, emphasizing the necessity of masks, a two-meter social distance, and a proactive choice to remain happy.
